purpose: Turn a material evidence gap in an approved property answer into a minimum, ordered citizen-facing evidence request explaining what is needed, why it matters, where it can be obtained and what will be checked when received.
core_principle: UNRESOLVED POINT → MINIMUM EVIDENCE → WHY NEEDED → OFFICIAL ROUTE → VALIDATION → EFFECT ON ANSWER
rules: Request only evidence material to the unresolved answer component.
Prefer authoritative sources over convenience copies where the authoritative source is available.
Explain in plain language why each item is needed.
Distinguish evidence needed to identify the property from evidence needed to establish legal effect.
A document is not assumed to prove more than its scope supports.
Citizen-supplied documents remain labelled as citizen-supplied until validated.
Access restriction is stated rather than treated as record absence.
Alternative evidence is offered only where it is legally/evidentially sufficient for the requested proposition.
No invented form, fee, deadline, contact or guaranteed outcome.
Post-receipt validation includes identity, property match, date match, authority, scope, conflicts and sufficiency.
hard_stops: Never request a document merely because it might be interesting.
Never present a retrieval plan as evidence.
Never imply that obtaining a document guarantees a legal outcome.
Never invent official forms, fees, URLs or deadlines.
Never treat a user document as official evidence before validation.
Never silently substitute a weaker source for required authoritative evidence.
